serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
It’s night, but everything is lit so well. Even though the public lighting is not working right now.
Burning cars, trash cans and other flammable things provide good enough light to not trip on debris scattered all over streets.
I would want to say that it’s a moonless night to sound more romantic, but I have no idea if that’s the truth.
Moon might be out there, covered by layers of filth, smog, smoke…
Lingering flames cast shadows of people cheering, running, chasing. 
In big cities people tend to be active even at night, not like in a small city like where I’m from.
People here go to clubs and party till morning. 
Almost every night there are concerts somewhere, but compared to what is happening now it’s all just normal.
I can only hope that something like this never happens again in my lifetime.
Seeing the worst humanity has to offer one time is one time too much.
There’s some commotion ahead of me. 
People are gathered in a circle, they are laughing disturbingly and I can hear loud thuds of kicks and punches.
These aren’t good people, that’s for sure…
Going there wouldn’t do me any good, but maybe my pointless night walk wouldn’t be so worthless if I witness something interesting. 
Maybe I will have a story to tell that would interest people in me or just give them a quick laugh.
I just need to come a little closer to see what’s happening…
???: Cease it at once! Thugs!
I recognize this mechanical voice…
So that’s where our Priestbot was this whole time.
Right now he’s upside down in a trashcan, as a bunch of lowlifes are kicking him and laughing to the point of almost gagging.
I don’t see the hilarity of this situation, but maybe if I was as intoxicated as these men my perspective would be different.
I need to help him, but I have no idea how…
Shanice would do something stupid in this situation so I can’t really go to her for aid.
The last thing I need is Shanice charging at them with a broom…
Coming up to them and politely asking to stop isn’t an option either, I suppose.
I’m close to the place where that one hobo I acquainted hangs around.
Maybe if I ask him nicely he will help me rescue Priestbot?
It’s worth a shot. It’s not like I have any other idea.
